tools.name: search_grants
tools.description: Finds public funding records by program name, notice number, Assistance Listing number, or topic. Results include sources and date roles for open calls, standing programs, forecasts, and closed records. Search does not establish applicant eligibility.

tools.name: get_grant
tools.description: Reads one public grant by its exact GrantSights ID or slug. Returns quoted eligibility evidence, applicant classes, funding amounts, application dates, notice expiration, source links, and freshness. Cutoff times and time zones are included when supported by the record for the relevant application t

tools.name: open_grant_review
tools.description: Reads one public grant by its exact GrantSights ID or slug and opens a blank applicant fit form in hosts that support the interactive view. Returns public evidence without running an assessment, storing applicant facts, or submitting an application.

tools.name: assess_grant_fit
tools.description: Checks one exact public grant against applicant facts supplied or confirmed for this assessment. Returns apply, review, watch, or skip with reasons, blockers, missing facts, quoted eligibility evidence, and the date for the specified application track when known. Does not estimate award probability

tools.name: find_organization
tools.description: Finds a US nonprofit by name or EIN in a state, from the IRS exempt organizations file. Returns up to 8 matches with EIN, city, cause and budget band.

tools.name: find_funders
tools.description: Ranks the private foundations most likely to fund a US nonprofit, from their 990-PF giving. Takes the organization's EIN, or its state and causes. Returns how many foundations passed every check and the top 3, each with its fit, why, whether it takes requests (with the filing year and any dated webs

tools.name: get_funder
tools.description: One private foundation's public summary from its 990-PF filings: whether it takes requests, with the source year and any dated website check, total giving and its years, and its newest grant. A past grant shows what a foundation funded, not that it accepts requests now or that this organization is e

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_grant_review · Private data: search_grants, get_grant, find_organization, find_funders, get_funder · Public sink: assess_grant_fit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_grant_review · Private data: search_grants, get_grant, find_organization, find_funders, get_funder · Public sink: assess_grant_fit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
